items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Shearing and I, and John Levy, Denzil Best; we had a quartet at a club called the Clique.

ctx.x: Well, maybe we could talk a little bit more about some of the people you were playing side-by-side with in the late ‘40’s. After you left Dorsey, I think for the last time, was your base New York for a little while, ‘cause you played with Bud Powell. Or they played with you, is really more appropriate.
Oh yeah. Yeah, George Shearing and I, and John Levy, Denzil Best; we had a quartet at a club called the Clique. This was the late ‘40’s, I guess.
